industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Khen Energy Limited
summary: Khen Energy Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the generation and sale of energy and power generation services in Singapore and Sri Lanka. The company is involved in the ownership and leasing of hydropower generation equipment and accommodation modules. It also offers ship owning and chartering, shipping agency, and management services, as well as generates and supplies hydroelectric power.
